first-class.larga: In 1962, at the height of the Cold War, young telepath Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr, a Holocaust survivor who can control metal, cross paths while hunting the same man: Sebastian Shaw, leader of the Hellfire Club. The CIA asks for their help, and together they recruit the first young mutants as the world edges towards the Cuban Missile Crisis. It is the chronological starting point of the saga: this is where the friendship and rivalry between Professor X and Magneto begins, and where the young versions of Mystique, Beast and Havok are introduced.

cambios.nota: Younger version of the character; Stewart remains the older Xavier.
Younger version; McKellen remains the older Magneto.
Younger version of Raven.
Younger version, before his full transformation.
Here she is a CIA agent; in The Last Stand she was a doctor.

extras.d: Around 13 cut scenes (about 14 minutes), including a gag where Charles makes Erik appear in drag during a recruitment.
Eight-part making-of documentary running over an hour.

origins-wolverine.larga: From the mid-19th century to the late seventies: Logan and his half-brother Victor Creed fight through several wars together before joining a mutant team under Colonel William Stryker. Years later, when Logan tries to live a quiet life in Canada, his past comes looking for him and he ends up in the Weapon X program, which coats his skeleton in adamantium. It tells Wolverine's origin and marks the first big-screen appearance of Deadpool (Ryan Reynolds) and Gambit, plus a teenage Cyclops.

cambios.nota: Here he is Logan's half-brother; Tyler Mane played him in the first film.
Younger version of the officer.
Teenage Scott in a brief appearance.

extras.d: Theatres showed two different final scenes depending on the print; the one with Logan drinking in a bar in Japan was left out of the home release, which uses the Deadpool one.
extras.donde: Blu-ray and two-disc DVD (deleted and alternate scenes)

pcs.d: Stryker walks barefoot and bleeding down a road when military police stop him: he is wanted for questioning over the death of General Munson, whom he killed himself to protect his experiment.
pcs.conecta: Leaves Stryker free to return as the villain of X2 (2003), played by Brian Cox.

pcs.d: In the tower rubble, the hand of the beheaded Weapon XI crawls to his head, which opens its eyes and goes "shhh" at the camera. Some theatrical prints showed a different scene instead: Logan drinking in a bar in Japan, saying he drinks "to remember".
pcs.conecta: Deadpool came back rebooted in Deadpool (2016), which mocks this version; the bar scene pointed to The Wolverine (2013).

xmen1.larga: In the not-too-distant future, mutants are feared and a senator wants to force them to register. Rogue, a girl who drains the life from anyone she touches, runs away from home and meets Wolverine, a clawed loner with no memory of his past; both end up at Professor Xavier's school just as Magneto prepares his answer to humanity. The film that kicked off the modern superhero movie era, it introduces Xavier, Magneto, Wolverine, Cyclops, Jean Grey, Storm, Mystique and Sabretooth.

extras.d: 2003 edition that lets you branch six deleted scenes back into the film, for about 111 minutes.

x2.larga: An attempt on the US President's life by a teleporting mutant gives Colonel William Stryker the perfect excuse to raid Xavier's school. While Wolverine hunts for clues about his past, the X-Men are forced into an uneasy alliance with Magneto and Mystique against a common enemy. It expands the cast with Nightcrawler, gives more weight to students Rogue, Iceman and Pyro, and plants the seeds of the Phoenix.

cambios.nota: Brief appearance as a student at the school.
He had a single line in the first film; here the role grows.
From cameo to an action role.
Brief appearance as a student.

extras.d: Eleven cut scenes, including a longer Wolverine vs Lady Deathstrike fight and Jubilee at the museum.

last-stand.larga: A pharmaceutical company announces a “cure” that can suppress the mutant gene, splitting mutants between those who see it as salvation and those who see it as a threat. Magneto seizes the moment to raise an army, while the X-Men, still grieving, discover that Jean Grey has returned with a power no one understands. It closes the original trilogy and introduces a full-fledged Beast, Angel, a bigger role for Kitty Pryde and Moira MacTaggert.

cambios.nota: In X2 he appeared for a moment on TV, in human form.
First time with a substantial role.

extras.t: Deleted scenes and three alternate endings
extras.d: Over twenty scenes and alternate takes, including a different introduction for Beast and Logan, plus three alternate endings, with optional commentary by Brett Ratner.

pcs.d: Moira MacTaggert checks on a comatose patient. He greets her in Charles Xavier's voice: the Professor transferred his mind into another body before Jean disintegrated him.
pcs.conecta: Explains why Xavier is alive in The Wolverine's (2013) credits scene and in X-Men: Days of Future Past (2014).

the-wolverine.larga: Logan is living apart from the world, haunted by the events of The Last Stand, when a young woman named Yukio brings him to Tokyo to say goodbye to Yashida, a Japanese soldier he saved at Nagasaki in 1945. The old man offers him something unexpected: freedom from his immortality. Soon Logan is caught in a war between the yakuza, a ninja clan and the Yashida family, with his healing power fading. It is Wolverine's most personal story and it leads into Days of Future Past.

extras.d: Unrated extended cut, longer and more violent than the theatrical version.
A variant of the final scene in which Logan receives his classic yellow costume from the comics.

pcs.t: Magneto and Xavier at the airport
pcs.d: Two years later, Logan walks through an airport showing ads for Trask Industries. All the metal freezes: Magneto appears with his powers back and, behind him, a living Charles Xavier. They warn Logan that someone wants to wipe out mutants and that they need him.
pcs.conecta: Leads straight into X-Men: Days of Future Past (2014), with Trask and his Sentinels as the threat.

dofp.larga: In 2023, the Sentinels, robots that adapt to any power, have devastated mutants and humans alike. The last X-Men, with Xavier and Magneto on the same side again, send Wolverine's consciousness back to his 1973 body to stop the event that launched Bolivar Trask's program. There he must convince a broken young Charles and an imprisoned Erik to work together. It unites the classic cast with the First Class cast, introduces Quicksilver and reshapes the timeline of the whole saga.

cambios.nota: Younger version, in 1973; Brian Cox played him in X2.
Brief appearance in the seventies.
Debatable as the same character: in The Last Stand he was a Trask with no first name heading Homeland Security; here he is Bolivar Trask, creator of the Sentinels.

extras.d: 2015 alternate cut that restores Rogue's (Anna Paquin) future subplot, with about 17 minutes of unused footage.
extras.donde: Blu-ray and digital purchase (not the Disney+ version)

pcs.t: En Sabah Nur in ancient Egypt
pcs.d: A crowd chants the name of En Sabah Nur as he, young, raises the blocks of a pyramid with his mind. Four horsemen watch from a hilltop.
pcs.conecta: Introduces Apocalypse and his Four Horsemen, villains of X-Men: Apocalypse (2016).

apocalypse.larga: In 1983, ten years after Days of Future Past, En Sabah Nur, believed to be the first mutant in history, awakens in Egypt after thousands of years buried. Determined to wipe out the modern world, he recruits four horsemen, among them a Magneto who was trying to live in peace. Meanwhile, Xavier's school welcomes a new generation of students. It introduces the young versions of Jean Grey, Cyclops, Storm and Nightcrawler, who carry on into Dark Phoenix.

cambios.nota: Younger version.
Younger version; Tim Pocock played him as a teen in Origins.
Younger version.
Younger version.
Here he becomes Archangel.
Small role at the school.
In The Last Stand it was a minor role with barely any lines.

extras.d: About 28 minutes of cut footage with introductions by Bryan Singer, such as a longer trip by the students to the mall.
About 8 minutes of bloopers.

pcs.d: At the Weapon X facility at Alkali Lake, men in suits collect vials of Wolverine's blood labelled "Weapon X" and put them in a briefcase marked Essex Corp.
pcs.conecta: Essex points to Mister Sinister, who never appeared; writer Simon Kinberg tied it to Logan (2017), whose lab-made mutants echo this scene.

dark-phoenix.larga: In 1992 the X-Men are national heroes and Xavier keeps accepting ever riskier missions. During a rescue in space, Jean Grey is exposed to a cosmic force that amplifies her powers and awakens memories Charles had hidden from her. As the team splits over how to help her, an alien race takes an interest in that power. It closes the chapter of the saga that began with First Class and is the second big-screen take on the Phoenix story.

extras.d: Five cut scenes (over 8 minutes), such as Charles returning home and saying goodbye, with optional commentary by Simon Kinberg and Hutch Parker.

deadpool1.larga: Wade Wilson, a motor-mouthed former mercenary, is diagnosed with terminal cancer and accepts an experimental treatment that gives him brutal healing powers at the cost of leaving him disfigured. As Deadpool, he sets out to find the man responsible, while Colossus and Negasonic Teenage Warhead try to recruit him to the X-Men. It breaks the fourth wall, mocks the saga itself and reinvents the character after his turn in Origins: Wolverine.

cambios.nota: Digital character; the original actor does not return.

extras.d: Cut footage with commentary by Tim Miller, including a montage of Deadpool taking out mercenaries and Wade visiting a quack doctor.
Bloopers from the shoot.

pcs.d: Deadpool appears in a bathrobe, like Ferris Bueller at the end of Ferris Bueller's Day Off, surprised you're still there. He says they only have money left to announce that Cable will be in the sequel and suggests actors to play him.
pcs.conecta: Announces Cable, who arrived in Deadpool 2 (2018) played by Josh Brolin.

deadpool2.larga: After a devastating personal blow, Wade ends up as a trainee at the X-Mansion and winds up protecting Russell, an angry mutant kid hunted by Cable, a soldier from the future. To stand up to him, Deadpool puts together his own team, X-Force, with unlikely recruits such as Domino. Bigger and rowdier than the first film, it introduces Cable and Domino and plays openly with the rest of the X-Men saga.

cambios.ahora: Digital character voiced by Ryan Reynolds
cambios.nota: Here he is a digital character; Reynolds voices him as well as playing Deadpool.

extras.d: Unrated extended cut with about 15 more minutes of jokes and action, plus some alternate material.
extras.donde: Blu-ray and digital purchase (not the Disney+ version)

extras.d: PG-13 re-edit with new scenes where Deadpool tells the story to Fred Savage, spoofing The Princess Bride.
extras.donde: Released in cinemas in December 2018, later on DVD

pcs.d: Negasonic and Yukio repair Cable's time-travel device. Deadpool uses it to save Vanessa and Peter, kill the Deadpool from X-Men Origins: Wolverine, and kill Ryan Reynolds right after he finishes reading the Green Lantern script.
pcs.conecta: Mocks X-Men Origins: Wolverine (2009); a living Vanessa is the starting point of Deadpool & Wolverine (2024).

new-mutants.larga: Dani Moonstar, a young Cheyenne woman, wakes up in an isolated hospital after surviving a disaster that destroyed her reservation. Dr Reyes tells her she is a mutant and that she is there with four other teenagers until they learn to control their powers. But the building starts conjuring each of their worst nightmares. It is the saga's foray into teen horror and introduces Magik, Wolfsbane, Sunspot and Cannonball, classic members of the comics' New Mutants.

extras.d: Seven scenes (about 11 minutes), such as Dani climbing the clock tower or snooping with Rahne in Illyana's room.

logan.larga: In 2029 mutants are nearly gone. An ageing Logan, his healing failing, works as a limo driver near the Mexican border and secretly cares for an ailing Charles Xavier whose power has become dangerous. The arrival of Laura, a clawed girl hunted by a paramilitary group, forces them across the country in search of a refuge that may only exist in a comic book. It is Hugh Jackman's and Patrick Stewart's farewell to their roles and introduces Laura (X-23).

cambios.nota: Older version of the mutant tracker.

extras.d: The entire film in black and white, conceived by James Mangold.
Six scenes (nearly 8 minutes), including an alternate dinner scene, with optional commentary by Mangold.

gifted.larga: Reed and Caitlin Strucker lead a quiet life in suburban Atlanta until they discover that their teenage children, Lauren and Andy, are mutants. Hunted by the government's Sentinel Services, they flee and find shelter in an underground mutant network led by Polaris, Eclipse, Blink and Thunderbird. It takes place in a world where the X-Men and the Brotherhood have vanished, and shows the everyday lives of persecuted mutants, far from the big heroes of the films.

legion.larga: David Haller has spent half his life in a psychiatric hospital diagnosed with schizophrenia, until he meets Syd, a patient who cannot bear to be touched, and starts to suspect the voices he hears are something else. A group of mutants helps him discover he may have immense power, while a government agency tracks him. With a very free visual and narrative style, it is the oddity of the saga and explores the son of Charles Xavier.

cambios.antes: Patrick Stewart and James McAvoy (X-Men films, 2000–2019)
cambios.nota: Appears in season three (2019), as the show's own younger version.

pcs.d: On a balcony at Summerland, David and Syd are talking when a small metal orb appears, scans David and sucks him inside. With David yelling "Help me!" from within, the orb flies off into the night.
pcs.conecta: Sets up Season 2: David returns a year later with no memory of where he has been.

xmen-tas.larga: Wolverine, Cyclops, Storm, Rogue, Gambit, Beast, Jean Grey and Jubilee defend a world that fears them, under Professor Xavier. Over five seasons they face Magneto, the Sentinels, Apocalypse and Mister Sinister, and faithfully adapt major comic sagas such as Days of Future Past and the Dark Phoenix Saga. It was the gateway to the X-Men for a whole generation and is essential viewing before X-Men '97, which continues it directly.

xmen97.larga: After Professor Xavier's apparent death, the X-Men carry on with Cyclops in charge, but the world still refuses to accept them. The arrival of an unexpected ally with a very dark past and new threats against mutants test the team in a season full of twists. It picks up right where the nineties animated series left off, with the same style and many of the original voices, and proves the format is still alive.

cambios.nota: Spencer died in 2020.
She based her performance on Disher's.
Hemblen died in 2020.
Court preferred that an Asian-American actress take the role.

extras.d: 56-minute documentary on the birth of the nineties series and its return thirty years later.

pcs.d: In the ruins of Genosha, a hand pulls a torn Gambit card from a crater. It is an older Apocalypse, who mourns: "So much pain, my children. So much death."
pcs.conecta: Sets up Apocalypse as Season 2's big threat and hints at Gambit's return.

pcs.t: S2·E4: Captain America and Black Widow
pcs.d: Back in the 1990s, Wolverine meets Captain America and Black Widow, who hand him a file on the Weapon X program. Cap asks if he plans to go alone; Logan says he has put a crew together.
pcs.conecta: Nods to Uncanny X-Men #268 and sets up the Weapon X story in the next episode.

pcs.d: Valerie Cooper shoots her newly arrived double and is revealed as Mystique, who leafs through her own file. A news report says Graydon Creed, Mystique's mutant-hating son, is the new US President.
pcs.conecta: Sets up Season 3 with Mystique inside the government and Creed in the White House.

cap1.larga: In 1942 Steve Rogers, a scrawny Brooklyn kid rejected by the army again and again, is chosen for a secret program that turns him into the super-soldier Captain America. Meanwhile Johann Schmidt, the Red Skull, uses the power of a mysterious cube to push Hydra beyond the Nazis. It is where the whole MCU begins in chronological order: it introduces Steve, Peggy Carter, Bucky Barnes, Howard Stark and the Tesseract, key to the Infinity Saga.

cambios.nota: Younger version, in the forties; Slattery remains the older Howard.

extras.d: Seven cut scenes, such as a tank attack in Norway and a Bucky battle.

extras.t: One-Shot: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
extras.d: The Agent Coulson short premiered as a bonus on this disc.

pcs.d: In the present, Steve takes out his anger on a punching bag. Nick Fury offers him a mission to save the world. A teaser for The Avengers follows.
pcs.conecta: Leads to The Avengers (2012), with Steve now on Fury's team.

oneshot-carter.larga: A year after the war, Peggy Carter works at the Strategic Scientific Reserve (SSR), where her colleagues sideline her to desk work despite her record. One night, alone, she gets a tip about the Zodiac, a mysterious serum, and decides to go after it on her own. This roughly fifteen-minute short served as a test run for the Agent Carter series and ties Peggy to the origins of S.H.I.E.L.D.

pcs.t: Dum Dum and Howard Stark by the pool
pcs.d: Dum Dum Dugan sits by a pool with Howard Stark, both marveling at two women wearing the newly invented bikinis.
pcs.conecta: A closing gag; Peggy has just been recruited to run S.H.I.E.L.D. alongside Stark.

agent-carter.larga: New York, 1946. Peggy Carter is still at the SSR, where her colleagues see her as Captain America's old flame rather than an agent. When Howard Stark is accused of selling weapons to the enemy, he secretly asks her to help clear his name, with his butler Edwin Jarvis as her partner. The second season takes her to Los Angeles. It deepens Peggy and Howard Stark and shows the roots of what will become S.H.I.E.L.D.

capmarvel.larga: In 1995, Vers is an elite Kree warrior with almost no memory of her past. After crash-landing on Earth in the middle of a war with the Skrulls, aliens who can take any shape, she teams up with a young Nick Fury to find out who she was before all that. It introduces Carol Danvers, one of the MCU's most powerful heroes, shows the early days of Fury and Agent Coulson at S.H.I.E.L.D., and plants the idea of assembling the Avengers.

extras.d: Expanded aspect ratio that fills more of the screen in scenes formatted for IMAX.
Six scenes (about 9 minutes), such as Yon-Rogg facing the Supreme Intelligence and Coulson unwittingly helping a Skrull, plus two minutes of bloopers.

pcs.d: At Avengers HQ, Black Widow, Captain America, Bruce Banner and War Machine watch Fury's pager, which has stopped transmitting. Suddenly Carol Danvers appears and asks where Fury is.
pcs.conecta: Bridges the end of Avengers: Infinity War (2018) and Avengers: Endgame (2019), where Carol joins the team.

pcs.d: Goose the flerken jumps onto Nick Fury's desk and throws up the Tesseract it had swallowed.
pcs.conecta: Explains how the Tesseract reaches S.H.I.E.L.D., where it is in Thor (2011) and The Avengers (2012).

ironman1.larga: Tony Stark, genius, billionaire and arms manufacturer, is kidnapped in Afghanistan by a terrorist group that orders him to build a missile. In a cave, with the help of another prisoner, he builds an armoured suit to escape instead, and once home he decides to change his company's course. The film that launched the MCU introduces Tony, Pepper Potts, James Rhodes, Agent Coulson and S.H.I.E.L.D., and drops the first hint of the Avengers Initiative.

extras.d: Expanded aspect ratio that fills more of the screen.
Eleven scenes, including more action in the final battle and Pepper finding a battered Tony after his return from Gulmira.

pcs.d: Tony comes home to find Nick Fury waiting. Fury tells him he's not the only superhero in the world and that he's there to talk about the Avengers Initiative.
pcs.conecta: The MCU's first connecting scene: leads to Iron Man 2 (2010) and The Avengers (2012).

ironman2.larga: Tony has told the world he is Iron Man, and now the government wants his suit, business rival Justin Hammer wants to outdo him, and the reactor keeping him alive is poisoning him. On top of that, Ivan Vanko, a Russian physicist with a score to settle with the Stark family, shows up with his own technology. It introduces Natasha Romanoff, the Black Widow, gives Rhodey his War Machine armour and expands Nick Fury and S.H.I.E.L.D. on the road to The Avengers.

cambios.nota: Rhodey himself acknowledges it with a wink on his entrance.
In Iron Man he only appeared in photographs.

extras.d: A discarded opening in which Tony, already sick from palladium, is unwell mid-flight, with Pepper tossing his helmet out of a plane, as seen in the trailers.

pcs.d: Agent Coulson arrives at a crater in the New Mexico desert and calls Fury: "We found it." In the middle, a hammer is stuck in the ground.
pcs.conecta: The hammer is Mjolnir: leads to Thor (2011).

oneshot-martillo.larga: On his way to New Mexico, where S.H.I.E.L.D. has located a strange object, Agent Phil Coulson stops for gas and finds himself in the middle of a robbery. What follows is a small demonstration of what a well-trained agent can do without armour or superpowers. This roughly four-minute short takes place right before the Iron Man 2 post-credits scene and Coulson's arrival at Thor's crater.

thor1.larga: Thor, the arrogant heir to the throne of Asgard, sparks a war with the Frost Giants and his father Odin banishes him to Earth without his powers or hammer. In a small New Mexico town he is found by scientist Jane Foster, while S.H.I.E.L.D. surrounds the spot where Mjolnir has landed and his brother Loki makes his move in Asgard. It introduces Thor, Loki, Odin and Jane Foster, gives Hawkeye his first cameo and leads directly into The Avengers.

extras.d: Cut scenes, including a longer sequence with Sif and the Warriors Three centred on Volstagg.
The short with Coulson and Sitwell premiered as a bonus on this disc.

pcs.d: Nick Fury takes Erik Selvig to a S.H.I.E.L.D. base and asks him to study the Tesseract, a cube that may hold untold power. Loki, alive and unseen by the others, appears in a reflection and says "Well, I guess that's worth a look"; Selvig repeats the line, under his control.
pcs.conecta: Leads to The Avengers (2012): Loki steals the Tesseract with Selvig under his control.

hulk.larga: Bruce Banner is hiding in Brazil, working in a factory and searching for a cure for what happens when he loses control. General Ross, determined to turn the Hulk into a weapon, tracks him down and sends a team led by Emil Blonsky, a soldier who becomes obsessed with matching his strength. It is the MCU's only solo Hulk film, introduces Ross and the Abomination, and hints at a crossover with other heroes.

extras.d: A discarded opening with Banner alone on the ice, briefly showing Captain America frozen with his shield.

oneshot-consultor.larga: After The Incredible Hulk, the World Security Council wants to release Emil Blonsky, the Abomination, and present him as a war hero. Agents Coulson and Sitwell, sitting in a diner, discuss how to sabotage the plan without it looking like S.H.I.E.L.D.'s doing and look for someone annoying enough to send. This roughly four-minute short ties up a loose end from The Incredible Hulk and shows how the Avengers Initiative was taking shape.

avengers1.larga: Loki arrives on Earth, seizes the Tesseract and takes control of several agents, among them Hawkeye, as the first step of an invasion. Nick Fury decides to activate the Avengers Initiative and bring together Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, the Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye, though their egos clash before they can act as a team. It is the MCU's first big crossover and closes Phase One, while opening the door to the cosmic threat that will shape the whole Infinity Saga.

cambios.nota: Ruffalo keeps the role for the rest of the saga.

extras.d: Nearly 15 minutes of cut footage across eight scenes: an alternate opening with Maria Hill being questioned after the attack, Steve Rogers alone in a café coming to terms with everyone he knew being gone (with a waitress, Beth, and a Stan Lee cameo), a longer conversation between Loki and the Other, and Captain America rescuing a family during the Battle of New York, among others.
extras.donde: Blu-ray (2012); Disney+ gathers MCU deleted scenes in the Extras tab

extras.d: About four minutes of bloopers from the cast.
Short about a couple who find a Chitauri weapon after the Battle of New York; it premiered as a bonus on this disc.

pcs.d: The Other tells his master that Earth is not as weak as they thought: to challenge it would be to court death. His master turns and smiles: it's Thanos.
pcs.conecta: Thanos's first appearance; he hunts the Infinity Stones up to Avengers: Infinity War (2018).

pcs.d: After the battle, the six Avengers eat shawarma in a wrecked New York restaurant, exhausted and silent. It pays off a line Tony says earlier.

oneshot-item47.larga: After the Battle of New York, the streets are littered with alien scrap. Bennie and Claire, a broke couple, find a Chitauri gun that still works and decide to use it to rob banks. Their heists catch the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D., which sends Agent Sitwell to recover the weapon before things get out of hand. It matters because it is the first look at what happens to ordinary people after The Avengers, and it foreshadows the tone of Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.

extras.d: The short was released as a bonus feature on The Avengers (2012) disc.
All One-Shots have been available individually on the service since January 2022.

pcs.d: Now in an agent's suit, Claire spins around in an office chair at S.H.I.E.L.D. headquarters, staring at the ceiling in boredom: she is Blake's new assistant, after he complained there wasn't even a spare chair.

ironman3.larga: Months after New York, Tony Stark can't sleep, suffers anxiety attacks and copes by building suit after suit. A terrorist known as the Mandarin spreads panic with bombings nobody can explain, and when the conflict turns personal Tony ends up alone, far from home and nearly without his tech. A Christmas story from Shane Black about the man inside the armour. It matters because it is the first film after The Avengers and shows how that battle left its mark on its heroes.

extras.d: Short in which Peggy Carter keeps working for the SSR after the war.
extras.donde: Iron Man 3 Blu-ray; also on Disney+

extras.d: A handful of scenes cut from a first assembly that ran over three hours.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.

extras.t: Commentary by Shane Black and Drew Pearce
extras.d: Audio track with the director and co-writer.
A cut four minutes longer, with an extended scene of Dr. Wu and his assistant (Fan Bingbing) and Chinese product placement.

pcs.d: It turns out Tony has been telling the whole film to Bruce Banner, who fell asleep. Bruce apologises: he's not that kind of doctor, not a therapist. Tony starts over and Bruce sighs. The card "Tony Stark will return" closes it.
pcs.conecta: Comic relief with no new plot; Tony and Bruce work together again in Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015).

oneshot-rey.larga: Trevor Slattery, the actor who posed as the Mandarin, is serving time in a prison where he lives like a celebrity, surrounded by fans and even a butler. A documentary maker arrives to interview him and Trevor happily reminisces about his career, never suspecting the visit hides something else. A short comedy starring Ben Kingsley. It matters because it answers the complaints about the Mandarin in Iron Man 3 and opens the door to the Ten Rings later seen in Shang-Chi.

extras.t: Debut on the Thor: The Dark World Blu-ray
extras.d: The short was released as a bonus feature on the Thor: The Dark World disc.
All One-Shots have been available individually on the service since January 2022.

pcs.d: In the same prison, Justin Hammer (Sam Rockwell) complains about all the attention Trevor Slattery gets and tells his lover about the parallels between himself and Tony Stark.
pcs.conecta: Brings back the Iron Man 2 villain; a gag with no follow-up.

thor2.larga: After restoring order across the Nine Realms, Thor returns to Asgard while Jane Foster, in London, stumbles on an anomaly that binds her to the Aether, an ancient and destructive force. Malekith and his Dark Elves awaken to reclaim it, and an attack on Asgard forces Thor to ask for help from the last person he wants to trust: his brother Loki, locked in the dungeons. It matters because it introduces the second Infinity Stone and the Collector, key pieces on the road to Thanos.

cambios.nota: Dallas could not return because of his commitment to Once Upon a Time.

extras.t: Marvel One-Shot: All Hail the King
extras.d: Short about Trevor Slattery in prison.
extras.donde: Thor: The Dark World Blu-ray; also on Disney+

extras.d: Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.
Track by members of the cast and crew.

pcs.t: The Aether goes to the Collector
pcs.d: Sif and Volstagg leave the Aether with the Collector, since keeping two Infinity Stones together in Asgard would be unwise. As they leave, he says: "One down, five to go."
pcs.conecta: Introduces the Collector and the Infinity Stones; leads to Guardians of the Galaxy (2014).

pcs.d: Back in London, Jane sees the Bifröst and runs outside: Thor has returned and kisses her. Meanwhile, a Jotunheim frost beast that crossed over during the final battle is still loose in the city, chasing pigeons.

cap2.larga: Steve Rogers lives in Washington, trying to adjust to the 21st century while running missions for S.H.I.E.L.D. alongside Black Widow. When Nick Fury discovers something is wrong inside the agency, Steve no longer knows who to trust, and a legendary assassin, the Winter Soldier, crosses his path. A seventies-style spy thriller. It matters because it shakes S.H.I.E.L.D. to its foundations, introduces Falcon and changes the course of the MCU and Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. for good.

extras.d: Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.
Track by the film's crew.

pcs.t: Strucker, the scepter and the twins
pcs.d: In a secret base, Baron Wolfgang von Strucker reveals that HYDRA is still alive and has Loki's scepter. He studies two caged prisoners, the twins Pietro and Wanda Maximoff, whom he calls "miracles".
pcs.conecta: Leads to Avengers: Age of Ultron, which opens with the raid on this base and introduces Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch.

pcs.t: Bucky at the Captain America exhibit
pcs.d: The Winter Soldier visits the Captain America exhibit at the Smithsonian in disguise. Standing before the panel about James Buchanan "Bucky" Barnes, he begins to remember who he was.
pcs.conecta: His story continues in Captain America: Civil War.

gotg1.larga: Peter Quill, abducted from Earth as a boy and now a space thief, steals a mysterious orb that everyone seems to want. He lands in prison alongside Gamora, Rocket, Groot and Drax, a band of misfits who can't stand each other and are forced to team up to escape and sell the loot. All set to a seventies mixtape. It matters because it opens up the cosmic side of the MCU, introduces the Guardians and finally shows Thanos in person.

cambios.nota: Brolin provides voice and motion capture from here on.

extras.d: 1.90:1 format that expands the picture in select sequences.
Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.
Commentary track.

pcs.d: Aboard the Milano, Drax sharpens his knives while Baby Groot, in his pot, dances to the Jackson 5's "I Want You Back". Every time Drax looks over, he freezes.
pcs.conecta: Baby Groot keeps growing in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2.

pcs.t: The Collector and Howard the Duck
pcs.d: The Collector sits in the ruins of his museum on Knowhere. Cosmo the dog licks his face and, next to him, Howard the Duck, one of his exhibits, mocks him with a drink in hand.
pcs.conecta: A gag: Howard the Duck only returns in cameos (Vol. 2, Avengers: Endgame); the Collector reappears in Avengers: Infinity War.

gotg2.larga: A few months after saving Xandar, the Guardians work as hired guns, and a job goes wrong because of Rocket. Mid-escape, a mysterious being called Ego appears, claiming to be Peter Quill's father. While Peter uncovers his origins, the rest of the team deals with old grudges, Yondu and Nebula. It matters because it deepens the Guardians' found family, introduces Mantis and plants seeds for Avengers: Infinity War and Vol. 3.

extras.d: 1.90:1 format that expands the picture in select sequences.
Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.
Seventies-style video featuring David Hasselhoff and the cast.

pcs.d: Kraglin puts on Yondu's fin to learn to control his whistling arrow, but loses control and sticks it in Drax's shoulder.
pcs.conecta: Kraglin masters the arrow in The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special and Vol. 3.

pcs.d: Moved by Yondu's funeral, Stakar Ogord (Sylvester Stallone) proposes getting his old Ravager crew back together: Charlie-27, Aleta, Martinex, Mainframe and Krugarr, the comics' original Guardians.
pcs.conecta: Never followed up: this team has not appeared again in the MCU.

pcs.d: The High Priestess Ayesha, humiliated by the Guardians, reveals the birthing pod where she is creating a more powerful being to destroy them, and names him Adam.
pcs.conecta: Adam Warlock appears in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3.

pcs.d: Peter Quill walks into the room of a now-teenage Groot and scolds him for the mess of vines while he plays a video game. Groot answers with an annoyed "I am Groot".
pcs.conecta: Teenage Groot returns in Avengers: Infinity War.

pcs.d: Stan Lee, sitting before a group of Watchers, tells them about his adventures on Earth; they leave and he keeps talking to himself.
pcs.conecta: A wink: it suggests Stan Lee is an informant for the Watchers in all his cameos.

iamgroot.larga: A collection of animated shorts starring Baby Groot, still a sapling, during the years he grows up aboard the Guardians' ship. In each episode, just a few minutes long and almost without dialogue, Groot gets into trouble with his reflection, with tiny aliens or with a dance that gets out of hand. Made to be watched in one sitting. It works as a light break in the marathon and fills the gap between Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 and Vol. 3.

pcs.d: Groot's drawing of the Guardians is seen floating adrift in space.
Groot sips his hot chocolate, but it is too hot; he swipes the mug off the table, it smashes, and Rocket (Bradley Cooper) shouts.

aos.larga: After the Battle of New York, Agent Phil Coulson, whom everyone believed dead, assembles a small S.H.I.E.L.D. team to investigate strange cases around the world. It includes Agent May, Ward, scientists Fitz and Simmons, and Skye, a hacker who doesn't trust the agency. Over seven seasons the show moves from case-of-the-week episodes to big arcs involving Inhumans, outer space and time travel. It matters because it ran alongside the films and reacts to events such as The Winter Soldier.

daredevil.larga: Matt Murdock was blinded as a boy, but the accident heightened his other senses to superhuman levels. By day he is a lawyer in Hell's Kitchen with his friend Foggy Nelson and Karen Page; by night, a masked vigilante fighting in back alleys. His path crosses Wilson Fisk, a businessman who wants to remake the neighbourhood his way. It matters because it is the first and most acclaimed of the Netflix shows, introduces Kingpin and leads to The Defenders.

pcs.d: After the credits of the Season 2 finale comes a roughly 24-second Luke Cage teaser: he takes a barrage of bullets without flinching, only annoyed about his torn clothes. "I guess you guys haven't heard about me?"
pcs.conecta: Announces the Luke Cage series (September 2016).

jessicajones.larga: Jessica Jones gave up a brief stint as a hero and now works as a private investigator in New York, relying on super strength, sarcasm and whiskey. A missing-person case forces her to face Kilgrave, a man who can control anyone's mind and who left her with traumatic memories. A noir series about trauma and control. It matters because it introduces Luke Cage and Trish Walker and is one of the pieces that lead to The Defenders.

lukecage.larga: Luke Cage, an ex-con with unbreakable skin and super strength, tries to keep a low profile in Harlem sweeping a barbershop and washing dishes at a club. The war between gangster Cornell "Cottonmouth" Stokes and his cousin, politician Mariah Dillard, threatens the neighbourhood and forces him to step up. A show full of Harlem soul and music. It matters because it gives the lead to the hero we met in Jessica Jones, introduces Misty Knight and sets up The Defenders.

ironfist.larga: Danny Rand, heir to a major company who was presumed dead after a plane crash, returns to New York fifteen years later. He grew up in K'un-Lun, a mystical city where he trained in martial arts until he earned the power of the Iron Fist. Reclaiming his life and his company pits him against the Meachums and an ancient criminal organisation, the Hand. It matters because it introduces Colleen Wing and completes the quartet of heroes who unite in The Defenders.

pcs.t: S2·E10: Matt Murdock in the confessional
pcs.d: Alive but hurt and bleeding from the nose, Matt Murdock sits in a confessional dressed in black: "I'd rather die as the devil than live as Matt Murdock."
pcs.conecta: Sets up Daredevil Season 3, where Matt fully embraces his vigilante side.

defenders.larga: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Iron Fist are each chasing their own cases in New York until they all end up pulling on the same thread: the Hand, an ancient organisation led by the enigmatic Alexandra. Four heroes who don't know each other and don't want to be a team have to learn to trust one another. An eight-episode miniseries. It matters because it is the crossover point for all the Netflix shows and is best watched before Daredevil S3 and The Punisher S2.

pcs.d: After the credits and the Marvel and Netflix logos, a one-minute teaser shows Frank Castle (Jon Bernthal) hammering his skull into concrete as he recalls his past.
pcs.conecta: Announces The Punisher series (November 2017).

punisher.larga: Frank Castle, a former Marine whose family was killed in a shootout, has taken out those responsible and lives in hiding under another name. A former NSA analyst, Micro, tracks him down and drags him into a military conspiracy tied to his past in Afghanistan. A raw action series about war and its aftermath. It matters because it gives a show of his own to the Punisher Jon Bernthal introduced in Daredevil S2 and continues the Netflix street-level line.

ultron.larga: The Avengers now operate as a team and raid a Hydra base to recover Loki's sceptre. Tony Stark, obsessed with protecting the planet without relying on heroes, uses what he finds to activate Ultron, a defence programme that doesn't turn out as planned. The Maximoff twins, Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch, join the threat. It matters because it introduces Wanda, Vision and the nation of Sokovia, and sows the tensions that explode in Civil War.

extras.d: Scenes that didn't make the final cut; Whedon ruled out releasing a director's cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.
Commentary track.

pcs.d: Fed up with his agents' failures (Loki, Ronan), Thanos takes the empty Infinity Gauntlet out of a vault, puts it on and decides to hunt the Infinity Stones himself.
pcs.conecta: Leads to Avengers: Infinity War, where Thanos crosses the universe for the stones.

antman1.larga: Scott Lang gets out of prison determined to turn his life around for his daughter, but with no job he ends up taking one last heist. The loot turns out to be a suit that can shrink its wearer, and its owner, scientist Hank Pym, has plans for him: stop his former protégé from turning that technology into a weapon. A heist movie with plenty of humour. It matters because it introduces Ant-Man, Hank Pym and Hope van Dyne, and mentions the Quantum Realm for the first time.

extras.d: Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.
Commentary track.

pcs.d: Hank Pym takes Hope to a secret room and shows her the prototype Wasp suit he designed with her mother, Janet. Hope replies: "It's about damn time".
pcs.conecta: Hope becomes the Wasp in Ant-Man and the Wasp.

pcs.d: Steve Rogers and Sam Wilson have Bucky pinned in a vise. They can't call Tony because of the Accords, so they're on their own; Sam says he knows a guy, meaning Scott Lang. It's footage from Civil War.
pcs.conecta: Leads to Captain America: Civil War, where Ant-Man joins Cap's side.

civilwar.larga: After a mission with civilian casualties, the world's governments demand the Avengers answer to the UN through the Sokovia Accords. Tony Stark backs them and Steve Rogers refuses, just as Bucky Barnes resurfaces as the suspect in a bombing. The team splits into two sides. It matters because it introduces Black Panther and Tom Holland's Spider-Man, breaks up the Avengers and leaves the board exactly as Thanos finds it.

extras.d: Taika Waititi mockumentary about what Thor was doing during Civil War.
extras.donde: Civil War digital release; also on Disney+

extras.d: 1.90:1 format that expands the picture in select sequences.
Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.

pcs.t: Bucky goes back into the freeze in Wakanda
pcs.d: In Wakanda, Bucky, who doesn't trust his own mind, chooses to go back into cryosleep until a way is found to remove HYDRA's programming. Steve warns T'Challa they'll come for him; T'Challa replies: "Let them try".
pcs.conecta: Leads to Black Panther, whose final scene shows Bucky healed in Wakanda.

pcs.d: In Queens, Peter Parker recovers and hides his new web-shooters from Aunt May. Once she leaves, he tests a gift from Tony Stark: a light that projects the Spider-Man signal on the ceiling.
pcs.conecta: Leads to Spider-Man: Homecoming.

team-thor.larga: While the Avengers fight over the Sokovia Accords, Thor is on holiday in Australia sharing a flat with Darryl, an ordinary office worker. A documentary crew follows their daily life: the rent, the shopping, an email to Tony Stark and Thor's habit of never chipping in a cent. Two shorts of a few minutes each by Taika Waititi. It matters because it explains Thor's absence from Civil War and previews the comic tone of Thor: Ragnarok.

extras.d: First short, premiered at Comic-Con 2016.
extras.donde: Captain America: Civil War digital release; also on Disney+

extras.d: Continuation with Thor and Darryl.
extras.donde: Doctor Strange Blu-ray; also on Disney+

blackwidow.larga: After Civil War, Natasha Romanoff is on the run and alone. A package from her past puts her in the sights of a mysterious assassin and forces her to reunite with the fake family she grew up with as an undercover spy: Yelena Belova, Melina Vostokoff and Alexei, the Red Guardian. Together they must face the Red Room that made them. It matters because it finally tells Black Widow's story and introduces Yelena, who becomes important in Hawkeye and Thunderbolts*.

extras.d: 1.90:1 format that expands the picture in select sequences.
Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.

pcs.d: Years later, after Avengers: Endgame, Yelena visits Natasha's grave and whistles the way they did as girls. Valentina Allegra de Fontaine interrupts and hands her next target: Clint Barton, whom she blames for Natasha's death.
pcs.conecta: Leads to the series Hawkeye, where Yelena goes after Clint; Valentina returns in Thunderbolts*.

blackpanther.larga: After his father's death, T'Challa returns to Wakanda, an African nation that hides its wealth and technology from the world, to be crowned king. His reign starts shakily: arms dealer Ulysses Klaue resurfaces and a stranger called Erik Killmonger arrives with a claim to the throne and a very different vision of Wakanda's role. It matters because it introduces Shuri, Okoye, Nakia and M'Baku and turns Wakanda into a key setting for Avengers: Infinity War.

extras.d: 1.90:1 format that expands the picture in select sequences.
Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.
Commentary track.

pcs.d: T'Challa addresses the UN and announces that Wakanda will stop hiding and share its knowledge and resources with the world. A delegate asks what a nation of farmers can offer, and he smiles.
pcs.conecta: A Wakanda open to the world is seen in Black Panther: Wakanda Forever.

pcs.d: In a Wakandan village, Bucky Barnes, without his metal arm, steps out of a hut; the children call him "White Wolf". Shuri tells him he still has much to learn.
pcs.conecta: Bucky returns to action in Avengers: Infinity War, in the battle of Wakanda.

homecoming.larga: After his adventure with the Avengers in Germany, Peter Parker returns to Queens and high school, hoping Tony Stark will call him for another mission. While he waits, he chases small-time criminals in the suit Stark gave him, until he runs into Adrian Toomes, the Vulture, who builds weapons from alien scrap. A high-school comedy with a superhero. It matters because it is Tom Holland's first solo Spider-Man film and picks up the fallout from the Battle of New York.

extras.d: Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.

pcs.t: Toomes and Mac Gargan in prison
pcs.d: In prison, Mac Gargan, another criminal Spider-Man stopped, tells Adrian Toomes he's heard he knows who Spider-Man is. Toomes, who owes Peter his life, denies it: "If I knew who he was, he'd already be dead".
pcs.conecta: Gargan is the Scorpion of the comics, but his story was never followed up in the MCU.

pcs.d: One of Captain America's school PSA videos talks about patience and admits that sometimes waiting isn't worth it, teasing everyone who stayed until the end of the credits.

inhumans.larga: In Attilan, a city hidden on the far side of the Moon, lives the Inhuman royal family, led by Black Bolt, a king whose voice can destroy anything. His brother Maximus stages a coup and the family ends up scattered across Hawaii, where they must survive among humans and find a way back home. An eight-episode miniseries. It matters because it was the attempt to give the Inhumans, a big part of Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., a show of their own.

drstrange.larga: Stephen Strange is a brilliant, arrogant neurosurgeon until a car crash wrecks his hands. Desperate after exhausting conventional medicine, he travels to Kathmandu looking for a cure and finds the Ancient One, who opens the door to the mystic arts and dimensions he never imagined. While he learns, a former disciple, Kaecilius, threatens the world. It matters because it opens up the magical side of the MCU, introduces Wong and Mordo and reveals another Infinity Stone.

extras.d: Continuation of Taika Waititi's mockumentary.
extras.donde: Doctor Strange Blu-ray; also on Disney+

extras.d: 1.90:1 format that expands the picture in select sequences.
Scenes that didn't make the final cut.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.

pcs.d: At the New York Sanctum, Strange offers Thor tea (a mug of beer that refills itself). He asks why he brought Loki to Earth; Thor explains they're looking for their father, Odin, and Strange offers to help.
pcs.conecta: Leads to Thor: Ragnarok, where this meeting is shown from Thor's side.

pcs.d: Mordo, disillusioned with the Sorcerer Supreme and her rules, finds Jonathan Pangborn, the paraplegic who healed himself with magic, and drains his power: the world has "too many sorcerers".
pcs.conecta: Never fully followed up: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness shows a different Mordo, not this one.

ragnarok.larga: Thor returns to Asgard after searching for clues about the Infinity Stones and finds that things at home are far from fine. The arrival of Hela, goddess of death, sends him to the other end of the universe: Sakaar, a junk planet ruled by the Grandmaster, where he is forced to fight as a gladiator against an old acquaintance. A space comedy by Taika Waititi. It matters because it reinvents Thor, introduces Valkyrie and Korg and leads straight into Avengers: Infinity War.

extras.d: Third mockumentary short: the Grandmaster moves in with Darryl.
extras.donde: Thor: Ragnarok Blu-ray; also on Disney+

extras.d: 1.90:1 format that expands the picture in select sequences.
Includes a cameo by Michael Rooker as Yondu, who was never meant to be in the film.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.

pcs.d: On the ship carrying Asgard's survivors, Thor and Loki talk about returning to Earth. Suddenly a huge ship blocks their way: Thanos's Sanctuary II.
pcs.conecta: Leads straight into the opening of Avengers: Infinity War.

pcs.d: On Sakaar, after the revolution, the Grandmaster crawls out of the scrap surrounded by rebels and tells them that since there's no revolution without someone to overthrow, it's only fair to call it a tie.
pcs.conecta: A gag: the Grandmaster hasn't returned in the films.

team-darryl.larga: Thor has gone and Darryl needs a new flatmate, so now he lives in Los Angeles with the Grandmaster, freshly ousted from Sakaar. The documentary crew follows him again as he tries to live with an eccentric tenant who has no intention of adapting to life on Earth. A Taika Waititi short starring Jeff Goldblum. It works as a comic epilogue to Thor: Ragnarok and closes the Team Thor trilogy of shorts.

extras.t: Debut on the Thor: Ragnarok Blu-ray
extras.d: The short was released as a bonus feature on Thor: Ragnarok.
Listed as a One-Shot on the service since January 2022.

cloakdagger.larga: Tyrone Johnson and Tandy Bowen are two New Orleans teenagers who, as children, lived through the same disaster on the same night. Years later he comes from a well-off family and she survives on petty cons, and when their paths cross again they discover linked powers: he melts into darkness and she creates daggers of light. A young-adult show with a social-drama edge. It matters because it expands the MCU on TV with two lesser-known heroes who later visit Runaways.

pcs.t: S1·E10: O'Reilly rises from the river
pcs.d: On the riverbank, a hand bursts from the mud and crushes a bee and a flower: it is Detective Brigid O'Reilly, presumed dead, who pulls herself up with glowing green eyes and a glitchy gait and walks into the woods.
pcs.conecta: O'Reilly is reborn as Mayhem, her dark half, a key figure in Season 2.

runaways.larga: Six Los Angeles teenagers who had drifted apart get back together one night at one of their homes. By chance they discover that their parents, respectable and wealthy people, belong to a secret organisation called the Pride and are hiding something terrible. From then on they must decide whether to stand up to their families and run away. It matters because it brings a much-loved teen hero group from the comics into the MCU and crosses paths with Cloak & Dagger.

antman2.larga: After the events of Civil War, Scott Lang is serving out house arrest and is days from finishing it when Hope van Dyne and Hank Pym ask for his help: they believe Janet, the original Wasp, is still alive in the Quantum Realm. To rescue her they must dodge the FBI, a tech dealer and Ghost, a mysterious enemy who can phase through walls. It is a light, family-driven adventure that introduces Hope as the Wasp and explains the Quantum Realm, which becomes key to what comes right after in the Avengers films.

cambios.nota: Lovitt played her young in flashbacks; Pfeiffer is the adult Janet from this film on.

extras.d: Two scenes, one of Janet guiding Hank through the Quantum Realm and one of Sonny Burch checking security footage, with commentary by Peyton Reed.
On-set bloopers, including Stan Lee's alternate one-liners and the whale-watching captain's improvisations.
Selected sequences open up to 1.90:1, with up to 26% more picture.

pcs.t: The Snap strands Scott in the Quantum Realm
pcs.d: Hank, Janet and Hope send Scott into the Quantum Realm from a van to harvest energy. While he's inside, all three turn to dust from Thanos's snap, and Scott is trapped.
pcs.conecta: Key to Avengers: Endgame: Scott gets out five years later and suggests time travel.

pcs.t: The giant ant plays the drums
pcs.d: In Scott's empty house, the giant ant that stood in for him plays the drums. The TV shows an emergency broadcast: the world is reeling from the Snap.
pcs.conecta: Shows the world after the Snap of Avengers: Infinity War.

infinitywar.larga: Thanos finally steps out of the shadows determined to collect all six Infinity Stones, and with them in his gauntlet he could wipe out half of all life in the universe with a snap. The Avengers are still split after Civil War, so the defence is spread across Earth, Wakanda and space, where the Guardians of the Galaxy cross paths with Thor. It is the culmination of ten years of films: almost every MCU hero meets here for the first time, and everything seeded with the Stones pays off in this story.

cambios.antes: Hugo Weaving (Captain America: The First Avenger, 2011)
cambios.nota: Weaving declined to return and Marquand took over, reprising the role in Endgame.

extras.d: About ten minutes, including Tony and Pepper discussing the wedding before Happy arrives and Wanda and Vision hiding in Edinburgh.
Bloopers and on-set jokes with the cast.
The Russo brothers and writers Markus and McFeely talk through the film.
The film opens up to IMAX's 1.90:1 aspect ratio.

pcs.d: In New York, Nick Fury and Maria Hill witness the chaos of the Snap: driverless cars, people vanishing. Hill turns to dust; Fury pulls out an old pager and sends a signal just before fading away. Captain Marvel's emblem appears on the screen.
pcs.conecta: Leads to Captain Marvel (the pager's origin, in the '90s) and to Avengers: Endgame, where she answers.

endgame.larga: After Thanos's snap, the remaining Avengers try to carry on in a world that has lost half its people. Five years later, Scott Lang's unexpected return from the Quantum Realm opens up a wild possibility: travel into the past and get the Stones first. It closes the Infinity Saga and the stories of the original Avengers; this is where the paths of Iron Man, Captain America, Thor and the rest are decided, and almost everything that follows in the MCU starts from these events.

extras.d: Six scenes, such as "Goji Berries", "Bombs on Board" and "Tony and Howard".
A different set from the disc, with commentary, including an early version of Hulk's visit to the Sanctum Sanctorum.
Flubs, goofs and gaffes from the set.
The film opens up to IMAX's 1.90:1 aspect ratio.

loki1.larga: The Loki variant who escaped with the Tesseract during Endgame's time heist is arrested by the Time Variance Authority (TVA), a bureaucracy that keeps the timeline from straying. Agent Mobius offers him a deal: help hunt down another, very dangerous variant in exchange for not being erased. This is the series that truly opens the multiverse in the MCU: it introduces the TVA, variants and branching timelines, and leads straight into the Multiverse Saga.

extras.d: Two scenes, including a Loki coronation seen in his file that features Frog Thor.
Bloopers and silly moments from the cast and crew.

extras.t: Marvel Studios: Assembled - The Making of Loki
extras.d: Documentary on the making of the season.

pcs.t: E4: Loki wakes up in the Void
pcs.d: Having been "pruned" by the TVA, Loki wakes up among ruins, surrounded by four other variants of himself: Classic Loki, Boastful Loki, Kid Loki and Alligator Loki.
pcs.conecta: Episode 5 reveals this is the Void at the end of time, where pruned beings end up.

whatif.larga: The Watcher, a being who observes the multiverse without being able to intervene, shows us what would have happened if key MCU moments had gone differently: Peggy Carter takes the super-soldier serum, T'Challa becomes Star-Lord, or Doctor Strange loses more than his hands. Each episode is a standalone animated story, although across the three seasons some of them start to cross over. Many actors from the films lend their voices, and the series introduces characters such as Captain Carter, who later makes the jump to live action.

cambios.nota: Voice only, in the original version.
Voice only, in the original version.
Voice only, in the original version.

extras.t: Marvel Studios: Assembled - The Making of What If...?
extras.d: Documentary on how the first season was made.

pcs.t: S1·E9: Someone inside the Hydra Stomper
pcs.d: Back in her universe, Captain Carter and Natasha Romanoff defeat Batroc aboard the Lemurian Star and find the Hydra Stomper armor with someone inside.
pcs.conecta: Season 2 reveals it is Steve Rogers, captured and brainwashed by the Red Room.

pcs.d: Audio only: at the end of the credits Darcy sings "Good Queen Darcy", a parody of "Good King Wenceslas" full of Marvel hero references, and wishes everyone happy holidays.

pcs.t: S2·E4: The Grandmaster, now a puddle
pcs.d: The Grandmaster survives the melt stick as a talking puddle and cheerfully begs Topaz to scoop him into a bucket.
Audio only: at the end of the credits Howard Stark, who directs Agatha's film in the episode, calls out "And cut!".

zombies.larga: Years after a zombie plague overran Earth in one of the What If...? realities, a small group of survivors, including Kamala Khan, Kate Bishop and other young heroes, searches for a way to end the infection while the fallen Avengers, now zombies, are still on the prowl. It is a four-episode animated miniseries, darker and more violent than usual for Marvel. It continues the zombie episode of What If...? and brings Phase 4 characters together in a survival story with no safety net.

yfnsm.larga: In this alternate reality, Peter Parker gets his powers in his first year of high school, but instead of Tony Stark it is Norman Osborn who takes notice and becomes his mentor. Between classes, new friends and a job at Oscorp, Peter learns to be Spider-Man while increasingly serious threats emerge in New York. It is an animated series with a classic comic-book look that reimagines the wall-crawler's origins and works as an entry point to the character outside the main continuity.

wandavision.larga: Wanda Maximoff and Vision live an idyllic life in Westview, a suburban town, as the stars of a TV sitcom that changes decade with every episode, from the black-and-white 1950s to the 2000s. But some details don't add up, and someone on the outside is trying to reach them. It is Marvel Studios' first Disney+ series and the starting point of Phase 4: it digs into Wanda's grief after Endgame, introduces the adult Monica Rambeau and sets Wanda up for Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

cambios.nota: Akbar played her as a child in the 1990s; Parris is the adult Monica.

extras.d: Two scenes from the final stretch of the series.
Fun outtakes from set with the cast and crew.
Featurette where the team explains how the series moves through different sitcom eras.

extras.t: Marvel Studios: Assembled - The Making of WandaVision
extras.d: Nearly hour-long documentary on the making of the show.

pcs.d: Monica sneaks into the basement of Agnes's house and finds roots glowing with purple energy. "Pietro" appears behind her: "Snooper's gonna snoop."
pcs.conecta: Confirms Agatha is manipulating Westview and that this Pietro works for her.

pcs.d: At the S.W.O.R.D. base, Director Hayward uses a drone charged with Wanda's magic to reactivate Vision's original body, now all white.
pcs.conecta: White Vision fights Vision in the final episode.

pcs.t: E9: A Skrull comes for Monica
pcs.d: As Hayward is arrested, an FBI agent reveals himself as a Skrull and tells Monica a friend of her mother's wants to meet her in space.
pcs.conecta: Leads Monica toward Nick Fury, Carol Danvers and The Marvels.

pcs.d: In a remote mountain cabin, Wanda makes tea while her astral form studies the Darkhold. Suddenly she hears her sons Billy and Tommy crying for help.
pcs.conecta: Leads straight into Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

eternals.larga: Seven thousand years ago, a group of immortal beings called the Eternals came to Earth to protect humanity from the Deviants, predatory creatures. After centuries apart living among us, a new attack forces Sersi and the others to reunite, just as an event approaches that could change everything. It is a cosmic-scale film that introduces ten new heroes, the Celestials and an unknown chapter of MCU history, with consequences for the planet after the return of the vanished.

extras.d: Four scenes: "Gravity", "Nostalgia", "Movies" and "Small Talk".
The funniest mishaps from the cast and crew.
Chloé Zhao and members of her team talk through the film.

extras.t: Marvel Studios: Assembled - The Making of Eternals
extras.d: Documentary on the making of the film.
Selected sequences open up to IMAX's 1.90:1 aspect ratio.

pcs.d: On the ship of Thena, Makkari and Druig, Pip the Troll appears and introduces Eros (Harry Styles), prince of Titan and Thanos's brother. Eros says he knows where their comrades taken by Arishem are and offers his help.
pcs.conecta: Never followed up: Eternals hasn't had a sequel and Eros hasn't appeared again.

pcs.t: Dane Whitman and the Ebony Blade
pcs.d: Dane Whitman opens his family's chest, which holds the cursed Ebony Blade, and hesitates to take it. A voice off-screen asks if he's ready; it's Blade (Mahershala Ali).
pcs.conecta: Sets up Dane as the Black Knight and Blade, but the Blade film has never been released and this thread remains unresolved.

shangchi.larga: Shaun lives a quiet life as a valet in San Francisco with his friend Katy, until attackers come after the pendant his mother left him. That brings out his real name, Shang-Chi, and his past as the son of Wenwu, leader of the Ten Rings organisation, whom he will have to face. It is a martial arts film steeped in Chinese fantasy that introduces Shang-Chi, his sister Xialing and the true origin of the Ten Rings, mentioned since the first Iron Man.

extras.d: Eleven scenes, about fourteen minutes, most without finished effects.
Flubbed lines, missed cues and on-set goofs.
Destin Daniel Cretton and writer Dave Callaham talk through the film.

extras.t: Marvel Studios: Assembled - The Making of Shang-Chi
extras.d: Documentary on the making of the film.
Selected sequences open up to IMAX's 1.90:1 aspect ratio.

pcs.d: Wong brings Shang-Chi and Katy to Kamar-Taj, where Bruce Banner and Carol Danvers analyze the ten rings by hologram: they're very old, not alien, and emit a signal to somewhere unknown. Wong tells them: "Welcome to the circus".
pcs.conecta: The rings' signal hasn't been followed up yet; Wong returns in Spider-Man: No Way Home and She-Hulk.

pcs.t: Xialing takes over the Ten Rings
pcs.d: Xialing, who was supposed to dismantle her father's organization, takes his throne and remakes it, training women and men alike. A title card reads "The Ten Rings will return".
pcs.conecta: Sets up a Shang-Chi sequel that hasn't been released yet.

fatws.larga: Six months after Endgame, Sam Wilson decides not to keep the shield Steve Rogers handed him, while Bucky Barnes tries to rebuild his life and make peace with his past as the Winter Soldier. A radical group called the Flag Smashers and the arrival of a new government-chosen Captain America force them to work together, with Zemo's awkward help. The series explores what it means to inherit Cap's legacy and charts the path that leads Sam to take on that role in the MCU.

extras.d: Two scenes: Sam and Rhodey bonding over flying, and Bucky at a Wilson family gathering.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.

extras.t: Marvel Studios: Assembled - The Making of The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
extras.d: Documentary on the making of the series.

pcs.t: E5: Walker forges his own shield
pcs.d: Discharged and grieving Lemar's death, John Walker forges his own version of Captain America's shield from scrap metal and his Medal of Honor, then paints it in the flag's colors.
pcs.conecta: Walker shows up with that shield in the final episode.

pcs.d: Pardoned and reinstated at the CIA, Sharon Carter steps out and makes a phone call: she plans to use her new access to sell government secrets and weapons.
pcs.conecta: Sharon remains the Power Broker, a thread still left open.

lovethunder.larga: Thor is trying to find inner peace while travelling with the Guardians of the Galaxy when Gorr the God Butcher appears, set on wiping out every deity. To stop him, Thor teams up with Valkyrie, Korg and his ex, Jane Foster, who surprisingly wields the rebuilt Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. It is a comedic adventure that introduces Gorr, Zeus and Omnipotence City, and picks up the story of Jane, absent since Thor: The Dark World.

extras.d: Four scenes, including the search for Zeus and more moments with Star-Lord and Mantis.
Three minutes of missed cues, dancing and laughter on set.
Taika Waititi talks through the film.

extras.t: Marvel Studios: Assembled - The Making of Thor: Love and Thunder
extras.d: Documentary on the making of the film.
Selected sequences open up to IMAX's 1.90:1 aspect ratio.

pcs.d: Zeus survived Thor's lightning. Humiliated, he vows revenge and orders his son Hercules to kill Thor, fed up with mortals worshipping superheroes instead of gods.
pcs.conecta: Introduces Hercules (Brett Goldstein), who has not appeared again in any film or series yet.

pcs.d: After her death, Jane Foster arrives in Valhalla, where Heimdall greets her and thanks her for looking after his son Axl.

moonknight.larga: Steven Grant, a shy museum gift-shop worker in London, suffers blackouts and strange dreams he can't explain. He soon discovers he shares a body with Marc Spector, a mercenary serving Khonshu, the Egyptian moon god, and that a cult leader, Arthur Harrow, wants to free another goddess. It is a series almost independent from the rest of the MCU, mixing adventure and psychological thriller, that introduces Moon Knight, Layla and Marvel's Egyptian pantheon.

extras.d: Two scenes: Layla questioning Marc's state of mind and a speech by Arthur to his followers.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.
Featurette on the show's Egyptian mythology with Egyptologist Ramy Romany and Oscar Isaac.

extras.t: Marvel Studios: Assembled - The Making of Moon Knight
extras.d: Documentary on the making of the series.

pcs.d: Arthur Harrow is wheeled out of the psychiatric hospital and put into a limo where Khonshu waits and introduces "my friend, Jake Lockley." The driver is Marc's third personality; speaking Spanish, he tells Harrow it's his turn to lose and shoots him.
pcs.conecta: Reveals Marc Spector's third identity and that Khonshu still has a use for it.

peter-lista.larga: The night before the class trip to Europe, Peter Parker has a list of errands to run before he packs, and some of them sound pretty suspicious out of context. With Ned alongside, he goes around the neighbourhood ticking off tasks while, of course, running into trouble he has to handle as Spider-Man. It is a roughly three-minute short built from a sequence cut from the start of Far From Home, so it works as a light prologue right before the film.

extras.d: Released as a bonus feature of Spider-Man: Far From Home, cut together from footage removed from the film.
extras.donde: Spider-Man: Far From Home Blu-ray and digital release

ffh.larga: Peter Parker just wants to enjoy the class trip around Europe and tell MJ how he feels, but Nick Fury has other plans: elemental creatures are attacking cities and a new hero, Quentin Beck, aka Mysterio, claims to come from another Earth to stop them. Meanwhile, everyone wonders who will fill Iron Man's shoes. It is the epilogue to the Infinity Saga: it shows how the world carries on after Endgame, introduces Mysterio and ends with consequences that lead straight into No Way Home.

extras.d: A roughly three-minute short with Peter's errands before the trip.
Including "Betty Blips", a bus rest stop with the class and Beck's green juice.
About three and a half minutes, with Tom Holland and Jake Gyllenhaal trying to crack each other up.

pcs.d: J. Jonah Jameson airs Mysterio's doctored video on TheDailyBugle.net: it frames Spider-Man for his murder and reveals to the world that he is Peter Parker.
pcs.conecta: Leads straight into Spider-Man: No Way Home, which picks up at that exact moment.

pcs.d: Nick Fury and Maria Hill were really the Skrulls Talos and Soren in disguise; the real Fury is relaxing aboard a Skrull ship in space.
pcs.conecta: Connects to the series Secret Invasion, which shows what Fury was doing in space.

sm-raimi1.larga: Peter Parker is a shy student living with his aunt and uncle in Queens and in love with his neighbour Mary Jane. On a school trip he is bitten by a genetically engineered spider and starts developing powers, while Norman Osborn, father of his best friend Harry, undergoes an experiment that turns him into the Green Goblin. It is the film that kicked off the modern superhero era and the origin of Tobey Maguire's Spider-Man, who years later returns in No Way Home alongside his Green Goblin.

extras.d: Bloopers and on-set jokes.
Cast screen tests plus costume and make-up tests.

sm-raimi2.larga: Two years after becoming Spider-Man, Peter Parker can't keep up: he loses jobs, fails at university and watches Mary Jane drift away. When his powers start to fail him, he considers giving up the suit just as Dr. Otto Octavius, after a failed experiment, becomes Doctor Octopus. For many it is the best Spider-Man film; it digs into the cost of being a hero and introduces a Doctor Octopus who returns years later in No Way Home.

extras.d: Extended cut with about eight extra minutes: new scenes, one alternate and several extended ones.
extras.donde: DVD and Blu-ray (Spider-Man 2.1); re-released in cinemas in 2025

sm-raimi3.larga: Peter Parker finally has everything going his way: New York loves Spider-Man and he plans to propose to Mary Jane. But an alien symbiote bonds to his suit, turns it black and brings out his darker side, while Harry Osborn seeks revenge and a fugitive, Flint Marko, becomes the Sandman. It closes Sam Raimi's trilogy and introduces Topher Grace's Venom and the Sandman, who returns in No Way Home.

extras.d: An alternate, slightly shorter version with reworked scenes and a different score.
extras.donde: Blu-ray (2017 limited trilogy collection) and digital

asm1.larga: Peter Parker, abandoned by his parents as a child and raised by his aunt and uncle, finds an old briefcase of his father's that leads him to Oscorp and to Dr. Curt Connors, his father's former colleague. There he is bitten by a spider and gains his powers, while Connors, obsessed with regrowing his arm, turns into the Lizard. It is Marc Webb's reboot with Andrew Garfield and Emma Stone as Gwen Stacy; his Spider-Man and his Lizard return years later in No Way Home.

extras.d: Eleven scenes, about seventeen minutes, mostly about Dr. Connors, including a different version of Uncle Ben's death.

pcs.d: An imprisoned Curt Connors is visited by a man whose face stays hidden. He asks whether Connors told the boy the truth about his father; Connors tells him to leave Peter Parker alone.
pcs.conecta: Teases the Richard Parker mystery and Oscorp, picked up in The Amazing Spider-Man 2.

asm2.larga: Peter Parker loves being Spider-Man, but he struggles to keep the promise he made to Gwen's father to keep her out of danger. Meanwhile Max Dillon, an Oscorp technician nobody notices, becomes Electro after an accident, and his old friend Harry Osborn returns to the city with a secret that pushes him toward the dark side. It closes Andrew Garfield's run; what happens here weighs heavily on his return in No Way Home, where Electro also reappears.

extras.d: Thirteen scenes, including an alternate ending in which Peter's father reappears.

pcs.d: Not a Spider-Man scene at all: it's a clip from X-Men: Days of Future Past. Mystique, disguised as a general, infiltrates an army camp in Vietnam and frees the mutants held there.
pcs.conecta: An ad for X-Men: Days of Future Past (a Sony–Fox deal); it doesn't tie into the Spider-Man story.

venom1.larga: Eddie Brock is a San Francisco journalist who has lost everything after investigating Carlton Drake, head of the Life Foundation. Sneaking into his labs, he comes into contact with an alien symbiote that bonds to his body, gives him enormous strength and talks to him from inside his head. It launches Sony's Spider-Man Universe, with Tom Hardy as Eddie and Venom, a funny and violent double act that will eventually cross paths with the MCU.

extras.d: Including Eddie bickering with Venom on a ride to the hospital and a longer version of the San Quentin scene.
A pop-up option that shows trivia on screen during the film about the comics and hidden references.

pcs.d: Eddie visits San Quentin to interview serial killer Cletus Kasady, caged alone in a straitjacket. Kasady promises that when he gets out, there's going to be carnage.
pcs.conecta: Introduces the villain of Venom: Let There Be Carnage.

pcs.d: Under a "Meanwhile, in another universe…" card, an animated clip from Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse featuring Miles Morales and Peter B. Parker.
pcs.conecta: A promo for Into the Spider-Verse; it doesn't continue Venom's story.

venom2.larga: Eddie and Venom are trying to live together as best they can, between domestic squabbles and the symbiote's hunger, when death-row serial killer Cletus Kasady asks to speak with Eddie. A bite at the wrong moment gives birth to Carnage, an even more savage symbiote, and Kasady escapes to reunite with his love, Shriek. It is a short, unhinged sequel that introduces Carnage and, in its post-credits scene, connects Venom to the MCU for the first time.

extras.d: Six scenes, about nine minutes, with alternate and extended takes, including a longer ending.

pcs.d: On a beach getaway, Venom tries to show Eddie his species' knowledge of other universes, and suddenly they're in a different room. On TV, J. Jonah Jameson unmasks Spider-Man as Peter Parker; Venom licks the screen: "This guy."
pcs.conecta: Pulls them into the MCU through Doctor Strange's spell, as seen in Spider-Man: No Way Home.

morbius.larga: Dr. Michael Morbius, a brilliant scientist with a rare blood disease, has spent years searching for a cure for himself and his childhood friend, Milo. His experiment with vampire bat DNA seems to work, but it leaves him with superhuman strength and a thirst for blood that is very hard to control. It is a Sony Spider-Man Universe film that introduces Morbius and, in its post-credits scenes, brings Michael Keaton's Vulture over from the MCU.

extras.d: Bloopers and on-set jokes; the disc has no deleted scenes.

pcs.d: Thanks to the No Way Home spell, Adrian Toomes suddenly appears in an empty cell in another universe. With no record of how he got there or any charges, he's released.
pcs.conecta: Brings the MCU's Vulture into Morbius's universe.

pcs.d: Toomes, back in his Vulture suit, meets Morbius. He blames Spider-Man for his situation and suggests they team up.
pcs.conecta: Hints at a Sinister Six–style villain team that never happened.

madameweb.larga: Cassandra Webb is a New York paramedic who starts having visions of the future after an accident. When she sees three teenagers about to die at the hands of Ezekiel Sims, a man with spider powers, she decides to protect them even though she doesn't fully understand what is happening to her. Set in 2003, it is a Sony Spider-Man Universe film that introduces Madame Web and three girls with a spider-powered future, and drops nods to the Parker family.

extras.d: Cassandra tells Ben that since the accident she keeps seeing things happen twice.
Bloopers and on-set jokes.

venom3.larga: Eddie and Venom are on the run everywhere: hunted by the military of their world and, at the same time, by creatures sent by Knull, creator of the symbiotes, who wants something Venom carries inside. Forced into ever tougher choices, they set off on a road trip toward New York. It is Tom Hardy's third and final film as Venom, introduces Knull and wraps up Eddie's story after his brief stop in the MCU.

extras.d: About twelve minutes of footage that didn't make the final cut.
About two minutes of on-set mistakes.

pcs.d: In his prison, Knull says this world's champion has fallen and he will conquer the universe: "The King in Black is awake." His face is shown for the first time.
pcs.conecta: Leaves Knull as a dangling threat in Sony's Spider-Man Universe.

pcs.d: The Mexican bartender, detained after Eddie left, walks out of the burned ruins of Area 51. Next to a broken vial that held a Venom sample, a black cockroach crawls out.
pcs.conecta: Hints that Venom may have survived.

kraven.larga: Sergei Kravinoff grows up in the shadow of his father, a ruthless Russian mobster, until a lion attack during a hunt leaves him with superhuman abilities. Years later, now Kraven, a hunter who goes after criminals, he must face enemies like the Rhino as well as his own family. It is the final film in Sony's Spider-Man Universe, with Aaron Taylor-Johnson as Kraven, and tells the origin of one of the wall-crawler's classic villains.

extras.d: Five sequences, about four minutes, with some extra Rhino moments.
On-set mistakes and jokes.

nwh.larga: After Mysterio reveals his identity to the world, Peter Parker watches his life and the lives of those he loves turn upside down. Desperate, he asks Doctor Strange for a spell to make everyone forget who Spider-Man is, but something goes wrong and villains from other universes start arriving, villains who know a Peter Parker, just not this one. It is the big crossover of all three screen eras of Spider-Man: it brings together Raimi's trilogy, Webb's films and the MCU, and sets the course for Tom Holland's Peter.

extras.d: Extended cut with about eleven extra minutes of new and longer scenes, plus a different post-credits scene.
extras.donde: Digital purchase; re-released in cinemas in 2022, never released on disc

extras.d: Bloopers and on-set jokes; the disc has no deleted scenes.

pcs.d: Eddie Brock chats with a bartender who explains the Avengers and the Blip; he decides to find Spider-Man, but Strange's spell sends him back to his universe, leaving a bit of the symbiote behind.
pcs.conecta: Eddie continues in Venom: The Last Dance; the symbiote fragment left in the MCU has not been followed up.

pcs.d: In cinemas it was a teaser trailer for Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. The 2022 extended re-release replaced it with Betty Brant pointing out missing photos of Peter Parker.
pcs.conecta: Leads to Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

mom.larga: Doctor Strange rescues America Chavez, a teenager who can travel between universes, from a creature hunting her. To protect her he turns to Wanda Maximoff, unaware of what she is willing to do after everything in WandaVision, and the two end up leaping through ever stranger realities. It is Sam Raimi's film, with his horror touch, that introduces America Chavez and pushes the MCU multiverse much further, continuing the stories of WandaVision and No Way Home.

extras.d: Three short scenes, including a journalist questioning Strange and more of Bruce Campbell's pizza vendor.
