Fun outtakes from set.
Sam Raimi, producer Richie Palmer and writer Michael Waldron talk through the film.

extras.t: Marvel Studios: Assembled - The Making of Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
extras.d: Documentary on the making of the film.
Selected sequences open up to IMAX's 1.90:1 aspect ratio.

pcs.d: The sorceress Clea (Charlize Theron) tells Strange his actions caused an incursion and he must help stop it. Strange, now with a third eye on his forehead, follows her into the Dark Dimension.
pcs.conecta: Introduces Clea; her story has not continued in any release yet.

pcs.d: The Earth-838 pizza vendor (Bruce Campbell), cursed by Strange to punch himself, finally breaks free of the spell and shouts at the camera: "It's over!"

hawkeye.larga: Clint Barton just wants to spend Christmas in New York with his kids, but the Ronin suit turns up at an underground auction and is worn by Kate Bishop, a young archer who idolises him. Together they must untangle a mess with the Tracksuit Mafia and with people who haven't forgotten what Clint did during the Blip. Six episodes with the feel of a Christmas action movie. In the marathon it introduces Kate Bishop and Maya Lopez, and brings Kingpin back into the spotlight.

extras.d: Behind-the-scenes documentary («The Making of Hawkeye») with cast and crew.

pcs.d: The full "Save the City" number from the Broadway show Clint walked out of in episode 1: a sung, goofy take on the Battle of New York from The Avengers.
pcs.conecta: Just a Christmas treat; it sets nothing up.

shehulk.larga: Jennifer Walters is a lawyer in Los Angeles and, after an accident with her cousin Bruce Banner's blood, she can turn into She-Hulk. All she wants is to keep her career going, but she ends up leading a new superhuman law division, with clients like Abomination or Wong, while trying to have a love life. It's a courtroom comedy that talks straight to the viewer. In the marathon it brings back Daredevil and ties up Hulk's threads after Endgame.

extras.d: Behind-the-scenes documentary («The Making of She-Hulk: Attorney at Law») with cast and crew.

pcs.d: At the bar, a drunk Jen cries that Captain America died a virgin until Bruce reveals Steve lost his virginity on a USO tour in the '40s.
Jen spends time doing chores at her parents' house, fixing the TV and hauling water jugs for her dad.
Jen and her new client Megan Thee Stallion dance around the office; when Holliway walks in, Jen says she'd die for her.
Wong and Madisynn, now friends, hang out on his couch watching TV and chatting about drinks.
Wong turns up at Emil Blonsky's cell and takes the Abomination to Kamar-Taj (which apparently has Wi-Fi).
pcs.conecta: Leaves Blonsky free and tied to Wong.

wakandaforever.larga: Wakanda mourns the death of King T'Challa while world powers push to get their hands on its vibranium. Queen Ramonda, Shuri, Okoye and the Dora Milaje then face Namor and Talokan, an underwater civilisation as powerful as it is hidden, with its own reasons to guard its secret. It is both a film about grief and a war movie. In the marathon it introduces Namor and Riri Williams, and shapes the future of the Black Panther mantle.

extras.t: Deleted scenes, gag reel and commentary
extras.d: Four deleted scenes (including Okoye facing the Dora Milaje and Shuri and Okoye in Haiti), a gag reel and commentary by Ryan Coogler.
IMAX Expanded Aspect Ratio in the scenes shot for it: up to 26% more picture.
extras.donde: Disney+ (pick the IMAX Enhanced version on the title page)

extras.d: Behind-the-scenes documentary («The Making of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever») with cast and crew.

pcs.d: In Haiti, Shuri burns her mourning robe and reunites with Nakia, who introduces Toussaint, her son with T'Challa. His Wakandan name is T'Challa.
pcs.conecta: Sets up an heir to the Wakandan throne; he has not appeared again yet.

echo.larga: Maya Lopez, the deaf fighter who ran the Tracksuit Mafia for Kingpin, flees New York and returns to Tamaha, her hometown in Oklahoma. There she reconnects with the family and Choctaw community she left behind, while Fisk's empire keeps looking for her. Five episodes that are grittier and more violent than usual for Marvel, rooted in the story of her ancestors. In the marathon it follows on from Hawkeye and sets up Kingpin's return in Daredevil: Born Again.

extras.d: Behind-the-scenes documentary («The Making of Echo») with cast and crew.

pcs.d: On his plane, Wilson Fisk watches with interest a news report about New York's mayoral race and its lack of a front-runner.
pcs.conecta: Kingpin runs for mayor in Daredevil: Born Again.

msmarvel.larga: Kamala Khan is a Pakistani-American teenager from Jersey City who draws Avengers fan art and dreams about Captain Marvel. A family bangle awakens hard-light powers in her and ties her to a story reaching back to the Partition of India and her own family. It's a high-school, family and rookie-superhero show, full of colour. In the marathon it introduces Kamala and leads straight into The Marvels.

extras.d: Behind-the-scenes documentary («The Making of Ms. Marvel») with cast and crew.

pcs.d: Department of Damage Control agents P. Cleary and Sadie Deever watch the video of Kamala at AvengerCon; they've never seen powers like that and decide to bring her in.
pcs.conecta: Damage Control hunts Kamala through the series.

pcs.d: Kamala lies on her bed in costume when her bangle glows and throws her into the closet. Out steps Carol Danvers, Captain Marvel, who sees posters of herself everywhere and runs off.
pcs.conecta: Leads straight into The Marvels.

ironheart.larga: Riri Williams, the young genius who built her suit in Wakanda Forever, is expelled from MIT and returns to Chicago with no money to continue her project. To fund it she joins a crew of criminals led by Parker Robbins, «the Hood», a charismatic man with a power that doesn't look like science. Six episodes where technology collides with magic. In the marathon it follows Riri after Wakanda Forever and opens the door to the supernatural in the MCU.

pcs.d: Parker Robbins, alive but hiding Mephisto's scars under a hoodie, walks into Zelma's mother's shop and asks for "some heavy duty magic." Zelma shows off her power but gives him no answer.
pcs.conecta: Leaves a possible Zelma–Hood alliance open.

secretinvasion.larga: Nick Fury returns to Earth after years in space and discovers that a group of rebel Skrulls, led by Gravik, has infiltrated governments and armies with a plan to start a world war. With no S.H.I.E.L.D. and no Avengers, he has Talos, Maria Hill and few other allies, in a spy series where nobody is who they seem. In the marathon it explains what became of the Skrulls after Captain Marvel and of Fury before The Marvels.

cambios.antes: Auden L. and Harriet L. Ophuls (Captain Marvel, 2019)
cambios.nota: Talos's daughter was a child in 1995; here she appears as an adult.

extras.d: Behind-the-scenes documentary («The Making of Secret Invasion») with cast and crew.

marvels.larga: Carol Danvers, Monica Rambeau and Kamala Khan all have light-based powers and, because of an anomaly, swap places whenever they use them at the same time. Forced to team up, they face Dar-Benn, a Kree leader trying to save her planet at the expense of other worlds, and Carol must confront what she left behind on Hala. It's a short, breezy space adventure. In the marathon it brings Captain Marvel, WandaVision and Ms. Marvel together in one story.

extras.t: Deleted scenes, gag reel and commentary
extras.d: Deleted scenes (including Kamala on Carol's ship taking a call from Valkyrie), a gag reel and commentary by Nia DaCosta.
IMAX Expanded Aspect Ratio in the scenes shot for it: up to 26% more picture.
extras.donde: Disney+ (pick the IMAX Enhanced version on the title page)

extras.d: Behind-the-scenes documentary («The Making of The Marvels») with cast and crew.

pcs.t: Monica in another universe with Beast
pcs.d: Monica Rambeau wakes up in another universe. A living version of her mother, Maria (here she is Binary), looks after her, and Beast, Dr. Hank McCoy (Kelsey Grammer) from the X-Men films, walks in.
pcs.conecta: First step bringing Fox's X-Men into the MCU; Kelsey Grammer returns as Beast in Avengers: Doomsday.

holiday.larga: Mantis and Drax see Peter Quill feeling down at Christmas and decide to give him the best present they can think of: travel to Earth and bring him his childhood hero, actor Kevin Bacon. Meanwhile, on Knowhere, the rest of the team gets the party ready. A roughly 40-minute special with songs and jokes that James Gunn shot alongside Vol. 3. In the marathon it bridges Thor: Love and Thunder and Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3.

pcs.d: Rocket and Cosmo decorate Groot as a Christmas tree; when he lowers his arms everything falls off. Cosmo says he ruined Christmas and Rocket tells the camera they'll have to make another special.
pcs.conecta: Just a gag; it leads nowhere (the Guardians' next step is Vol. 3).

werewolf.larga: After Ulysses Bloodstone's death, a group of monster hunters gathers at his mansion to compete for the Bloodstone, a powerful relic. Among them are Jack Russell, a hunter with a secret, and Elsa Bloodstone, the family's estranged daughter. A special under an hour long, shot in black and white as a tribute to classic horror films. In the marathon it opens up the supernatural, monstrous side of the MCU.

extras.d: Colourised version of the special, released on 20 October 2023.
extras.donde: Disney+ (separate title: «Werewolf by Night in Color»)

extras.d: Documentary by Anthony Giacchino about his brother Michael's directing debut on this special.

wonderman.larga: Simon Williams is a Los Angeles actor with talent, little luck and a secret: he has superpowers. When he learns that director Von Kovak is remaking the superhero film «Wonder Man», he goes all out for the part, and along the way he runs into Trevor Slattery, the actor who once posed as the Mandarin. Eight short episodes of Hollywood satire. In the marathon it's a comedy breather and brings back Trevor, seen in Iron Man 3 and Shang-Chi.

quantumania.larga: Scott Lang is enjoying fame after saving the world, but his daughter Cassie has been building a device to contact the Quantum Realm. A mishap pulls Scott, Hope, Hank, Janet and Cassie into that subatomic world, full of peoples and creatures, where Janet keeps secrets from the years she spent trapped there. Kang the Conqueror awaits. In the marathon it kicks off Phase 5 and presents Kang as a threat of the Multiverse Saga.

cambios.nota: As a child she was played by Abby Ryder Fortson (Ant-Man, 2015, and Ant-Man and the Wasp, 2018).

extras.t: Deleted scenes, gag reel and commentary
extras.d: Two deleted scenes («Drink the Ooze» and «I Have Holes»), a gag reel and commentary by Peyton Reed and Jeff Loveness.
IMAX Expanded Aspect Ratio in the scenes shot for it: up to 26% more picture.
extras.donde: Disney+ (pick the IMAX Enhanced version on the title page)

pcs.d: Immortus, Rama-Tut, Centurion and thousands of Kang variants gather after the Conqueror's death, worried that Earth-616 is starting to meddle with the multiverse.
pcs.conecta: Set up Avengers: The Kang Dynasty, which was never made: after Jonathan Majors was fired the saga pivoted to Avengers: Doomsday.

pcs.t: Loki and Mobius see Victor Timely
pcs.d: In 1893, Loki and Mobius watch Victor Timely, another Kang variant, presenting an invention at a fair.
pcs.conecta: Leads to Loki season 2, where Victor Timely is key.

loki2.larga: Loki starts slipping uncontrollably between past and present just as the TVA is in crisis after the end of season one. With Mobius, Sylvie, Hunter B-15 and the technician Ouroboros, he tries to fix the Temporal Loom before the timelines overflow, and looks for answers in Victor Timely, a 19th-century inventor. Six episodes of clockwork science fiction. In the marathon it is key to understanding the Phase 5 multiverse.

extras.d: Behind-the-scenes documentary («The Making of Loki: Season 2») with cast and crew.

pcs.d: Sylvie steps through a time door into a field in Broxton, Oklahoma, in 1982. She walks into a McDonald's and, puzzled, orders a bit of everything: nothing with a face.
pcs.conecta: Shows the quiet life Sylvie is after since killing He Who Remains.

ff2005.larga: Scientist Reed Richards persuades his old classmate Victor von Doom to fund a space mission to study a cosmic storm. The cloud hits them early and, back on Earth, Reed, Sue Storm, her brother Johnny and pilot Ben Grimm discover their bodies have changed; so has Victor's. A light, family-friendly Fox adventure. In the marathon it's the first big-screen origin of Marvel's First Family, with Chris Evans as Johnny before he was Captain America.

extras.d: Roughly 125-minute version with almost 20 extra minutes, mostly of Ben and Alicia Masters, plus a Sue and Victor dinner.
extras.donde: «Extended Edition» DVD (2007); Disney+ carries the theatrical cut

ff2007.larga: Reed and Sue are finally trying to get married, but a silver being soaring through space on a board starts causing strange phenomena all over the planet. The army asks the Fantastic Four to help catch him, and to do so they must deal with an old enemy. They soon learn the Silver Surfer is only the herald of something far bigger. In the marathon it closes Fox's era for the family and marks the Silver Surfer's and Galactus's first film appearance.

extras.d: Five scenes (almost 10 minutes) with optional commentary by Tim Story, including a longer opening.

pcs.d: The Silver Surfer floats lifeless in space, far from Earth. Just before drifting out of view, his eyes open and his board zooms toward him.
pcs.conecta: Shows he survived; no third film followed.

ff2015.larga: Reed Richards is a young genius who has built a teleporter in his garage. The Baxter Foundation recruits him with Sue Storm, Johnny Storm and Victor von Doom to open a gateway to another dimension, and an unauthorised trip, with his friend Ben Grimm, changes their bodies forever. It's a darker reboot with a science-fiction, body-horror tone. In the marathon it's the saga's curiosity: another take on the family, unconnected to the 2005 one.

deadpool3.larga: Wade Wilson has hung up the suit and sells cars, until the TVA tells him his universe is about to end because it has lost its anchor, the Wolverine who died in Logan. Wade decides to search other universes for a replacement and finds the worst Wolverine possible, a Logan crushed by his past. Together they end up in the Void, the multiverse's dumping ground, facing Cassandra Nova. In the marathon it joins Fox's X-Men world with the MCU and says goodbye to that universe.

pcs.d: As the credits begin, a montage of behind-the-scenes footage from 20th Century Fox's Marvel films (X-Men, Wolverine, Elektra, Fantastic Four…) set to Green Day's "Good Riddance (Time of Your Life)".
Deadpool, tired of rumours that he got Johnny Storm killed, plays the TVA footage: Johnny really did say every crude thing about Cassandra Nova that Wade repeated.

gotg3.larga: The Guardians have settled on Knowhere and Peter Quill is still reeling from losing Gamora. When an attack leaves Rocket badly hurt, the team sets off on a race against time to save him that leads them to the High Evolutionary, the scientist who created him. Along the way Rocket's past is finally revealed. It's the most emotional film in the trilogy. In the marathon it closes James Gunn's era with these characters.

pcs.d: The new team led by Rocket (Groot, Kraglin, Cosmo, Adam Warlock and Phyla) waits in a desert chatting about their favourite Earth songs, until a monster shows up and they go after it.
Peter Quill, back on Earth, bickers over breakfast with his grandfather Jason. A card reads "The Legendary Star-Lord will return".
pcs.conecta: Promises Star-Lord's return, with no title announced yet.

agatha.larga: After the events of WandaVision, Agatha Harkness is still stuck in Westview without her powers. A mysterious goth teenager frees her and asks her to lead him down the Witches' Road, a gauntlet of trials that grants whoever reaches the end what they desire. Agatha gathers a coven of down-on-their-luck witches and, along the way, runs into Rio Vidal, an old acquaintance. It's a mix of horror, comedy and songs. In the marathon it follows on from WandaVision.

extras.d: Behind-the-scenes documentary («The Making of Agatha All Along») with cast and crew.

daredevil-ba.larga: Matt Murdock has left the mask behind and focuses on his work as a lawyer in New York, while Wilson Fisk, who claims he has changed, runs for mayor and wins. With Kingpin running the city from City Hall, Matt must decide how far he is willing to go, and along the way Frank Castle reappears. Season two (March 2026) continues the struggle between them and brings back Jessica Jones. In the marathon it continues the Netflix series inside the MCU.

pcs.d: Frank Castle is locked in one of Fisk's secret prisons. He tricks a guard into opening his cell and goes after his captors.
pcs.conecta: Leads to The Punisher: One Last Kill and season 2.

punisher-olk.larga: Frank Castle believes he has nothing left to avenge and lives withdrawn from the war he has fought for years. But Ma Gnucci, head of the Gnucci crime family, has a score to settle with him and drags him back onto the streets of New York. It's a Marvel Television special presentation released on Disney+ in May 2026, co-written by Jon Bernthal. In the marathon it's the Punisher's own story after his appearances in Daredevil: Born Again.

bravenewworld.larga: Sam Wilson is now the new Captain America and works with Thaddeus Ross, now President of the United States, who is pursuing an international deal over the adamantium from Celestial Island. An attack right in the White House shatters that trust and Sam, with Joaquín Torres as the new Falcon, investigates a conspiracy that reaches very high. It's an action political thriller. In the marathon it follows The Falcon and the Winter Soldier and brings back villains from The Incredible Hulk (2008).

cambios.nota: Hurt played him from The Incredible Hulk (2008) until his death in 2022.

pcs.t: The Leader warns of other worlds
pcs.d: Sam Wilson visits Samuel Sterns at the Raft. Sterns warns him he has seen in the probabilities that this is not the only world, and that heroes will have to protect it from "the others".
pcs.conecta: Teases the multiversal threat of Avengers: Doomsday and Avengers: Secret Wars.

thunderbolts.larga: Yelena Belova does dirty work for Valentina Allegra de Fontaine and feels empty. On a mission she walks into a trap along with other expendable operatives, like John Walker, Ghost and Taskmaster, and a bewildered man named Bob. To get out alive they'll have to work together, with help from Bucky Barnes and Red Guardian. It's a team film about broken people and loneliness. In the marathon it brings together supporting characters from several films and series and sets up the Avengers to come.

extras.t: Deleted scenes, gag reel and commentary
extras.d: Deleted scenes (such as «Door is Unliftable» and «Gary Announcement»), a gag reel and commentary by Jake Schreier.

pcs.d: In a grocery store, Alexei (Red Guardian) urges a shopper to buy Wheaties because the New Avengers are on the box, just as he dreamed. She walks off without it.

Fourteen months later, in their tower, the New Avengers argue because Sam Wilson is suing them over the name; Bob refuses to become the Sentry again. An alarm goes off: an interdimensional ship with a "4" is entering Earth.
pcs.conecta: Connects to The Fantastic Four: First Steps and leads to Avengers: Doomsday.

eyeswakanda.larga: A four-episode animated series that travels through Wakanda's history via the Hatut Zeraze, warriors sent across the world to recover vibranium artefacts. Each episode is set in a different era, starting in ancient times, and crosses its heroes with historical events and other Marvel characters, such as an Iron Fist from the past. It's an anthology of standalone adventures. In the marathon it expands Black Panther's world and Wakanda's past.

ff.larga: On Earth-828, a retro-futuristic world inspired by the 1960s, Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Johnny Storm and Ben Grimm have been heroes for four years since the space flight that gave them their powers, and Reed and Sue are expecting their first child. Then the Silver Surfer arrives to herald Galactus, a being who devours planets. It's a film about a family before a team. In the marathon it introduces the MCU's Fantastic Four ahead of Avengers: Doomsday.

cambios.nota: New MCU version. John Krasinski played a Reed from another universe in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022).

pcs.d: Four years later, in the Baxter Building, Sue reads Franklin a story. She steps out for another book and returns to find Doctor Doom, green cloak and mask in hand, beside the boy, who touches his face.
pcs.conecta: "The Fantastic Four will return in Avengers: Doomsday".

pcs.d: An old television plays the animated intro of their world's Fantastic Four show, in the style of the 1967 series, until H.E.R.B.I.E. switches it off.

brandnewday.larga: Four years have passed since No Way Home and Peter Parker, now an adult, lives entirely alone after erasing himself from the memories of everyone he loves. Devoted full-time to being Spider-Man in a New York that doesn't know his name, he finds the pressure sparking a surprising physical evolution, while a strange pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the biggest threats he has ever faced. In the marathon it's Peter's fresh start, with the Punisher and Bruce Banner around him.

pcs.d: Ned's Spider-Man tracker app places him in New York, but it glitches and the map zooms out past Earth and the Moon to a spot in space. A card reads "Spider-Man will return".
pcs.conecta: Points to Avengers: Doomsday, though it doesn't say which Spider-Man it has found.

doomsday.larga: According to what has been announced, it opens in cinemas on 18 December 2026 and pits the Avengers against Doctor Doom, played by Robert Downey Jr. Marvel has confirmed a huge cast bringing together MCU heroes such as Thor, Sam Wilson, Bucky and Shuri, the Fantastic Four from First Steps and the X-Men from the Fox films, with Patrick Stewart and Ian McKellen. It's directed by Anthony and Joe Russo. In the marathon it's where every saga meets.

cambios.nota: The MCU's first Doom, as announced. Julian McMahon played him before (2005 and 2007).
